Aldorei's Secret Part I#000.src: Talk to the Elf Guard at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part I#001.src: Halt, traveler! Entry to {p} Town is forbidden at present.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#001.dst: 站住，旅人！{p} 镇目前禁止进入。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#001.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#002.src: There is a dangerous criminal on the loose in this valley.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#002.dst: 这座山谷里有个危险的罪犯逍遥法外。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#002.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#003.src: These doors shall remain closed until the criminal is captured.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#003.dst: 在抓到罪犯之前，这些门都会一直关着。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#003.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#004.src: See if anyone in {p} Valley knows what happened
Aldorei's Secret Part I#004.dst: 看看 {p} 谷里有没有人知道发生了什么事

Aldorei's Secret Part I#005.src: An outsider in our midst? Exciting to see. I have wished to share our magic with new people for a long while.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#005.dst: 外人来到我们之中？真令人兴奋。我一直很想把我们的魔法分享给新的人。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#005.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#006.src: However, I am...well, rather hungry. And I must tend to my garden here for the time being.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#006.dst: 不过，我……嗯，相当饿。而且我暂时得照料这里的花园。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#006.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#007.src: Have you heard the saying “You scratch my ears, I scratch yours”? People must help one another.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#007.dst: 你听过“你挠我耳朵，我挠你耳朵”这句话吗？人与人之间应该互相帮助。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#007.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#008.src: If you would be so kind as to bring me a loaf of fresh bread you may take my enchanted bucket.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#008.dst: 如果你愿意好心给我带一条新鲜面包来，我的魔法桶就可以给你。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#008.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#009.src: I saw you toil to bake this yourself. Frankly, that is above and beyond what I expected, so here is your exchange.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#009.dst: 我看到你辛辛苦苦亲手烤了面包。说实话，这远远超出我的期望，所以这是给你的交换。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#009.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#010.src: If you require help in the future with anything, do not be afraid to ask. If you put such effort for me, I shall give you the same.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#010.dst: 以后有任何需要帮忙的地方，别怕开口。你为我付出这样的心力，我也会同样回报你。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#010.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#011.src: Find a use for Damys' Bucket
Aldorei's Secret Part I#011.dst: 为 Damys 的桶找个用途

Aldorei's Secret Part I#012.src: This is utterly insane. A full lockdown, over a petty theft... Are we not to help one another? To thieve is unnecessary.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#012.dst: 这简直疯了。为了一件小偷小摸就全面封锁……我们不是该互相帮助吗？偷窃根本没有必要。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#012.speaker: Vaenr

Aldorei's Secret Part I#013.src: The thieving is not the reason, from what I have heard. It is that the grove was jealously hidden due to the potency of the plants there.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#013.dst: 据我所知，不是因为偷窃。而是因为那片林地里的植物药效太强，一直被刻意藏起来。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#013.speaker: Sylvar

Aldorei's Secret Part I#014.src: Tattytale, Iridesca, Subtraxerim... The Light only knows what else. It is impossible to reach without unusual means- And that is cause for grave concern.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#014.dst: Tattytale、Iridesca、Subtraxerim……天知道还有什么。不用特殊手段根本到不了那里——而这正是令人严重担忧的地方。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#014.speaker: Sylvar

Aldorei's Secret Part I#015.src: Find a way to grow the plant by the waterfall
Aldorei's Secret Part I#015.dst: 想办法让瀑布旁的植物长大

Aldorei's Secret Part I#017.src: Halt! This area is strictly off limits, especially for an outsider. Turn back now!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#017.dst: 站住！这里严禁进入，外人更是不行。马上回头！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#017.speaker: Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#019.src: Aha, the outsider returns. Is there something troubling you?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#019.dst: 啊哈，外人回来了。有什么烦心事吗？
Aldorei's Secret Part I#019.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#020.src: ...mmm. Unfortunate, that. I cannot help with this.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#020.dst: ……嗯。真不巧。这件事我帮不上忙。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#020.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#021.src: It is not a matter of secrecy or morals- I simply do not know what that leaf is from or what it may be capable of.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#021.dst: 这无关保密或道德——我只是不知道那片叶子来自什么植物，也不知道它有什么作用。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#021.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#022.src: I am no botanist- Simply a gardener. The mistake is understandable, if regrettable.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#022.dst: 我不是植物学家——只是个园丁。搞错也情有可原，虽然很遗憾。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#022.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#023.src: However, I was taught under a much more storied botanist who may have the answers you seek.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#023.dst: 不过，我曾经跟一位更有名望的植物学家学习过，她也许有你要的答案。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#023.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#024.src: Her name is Fiona- Her home is across the valley from here. Take the bridge across. She often stays inside studying.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#024.dst: 她叫 Fiona——她家在山谷对面。过桥就到了。她常常待在屋里做研究。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#024.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#025.src: She has forgotten more than I will ever hope to know about plants. If she cannot help you, I fear none can.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#025.dst: 她忘掉的植物知识都比我这辈子能学到的还多。如果连她都帮不了你，恐怕就没人帮得了了。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#025.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#026.src: Go to the botanist's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Aldorei's Secret Part I#027.src: This is outrageous! To think one of our own would stoop to such thievery and destruction!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#027.dst: 太过分了！真没想到我们自己人会堕落到这样偷窃破坏！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#027.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#028.src: Outsider, this is not the time to be asking me anything. My home has been ransacked!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#028.dst: 外人，现在不是问我事情的时候。我家被洗劫了！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#028.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#029.src: Mm? Damys sent you... You have leaves of Iridesca? Hm... Then perhaps we may be able to help one another.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#029.dst: 嗯？Damys 叫你来的……你有 Iridesca 的叶子？嗯……那也许我们可以互相帮助。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#029.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#030.src: They tore through my shelves and furniture searching, and scanned the pages as fervently once they found it.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#030.dst: 他们翻遍了我的书架和家具，找到之后又那么急切地翻看书页。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#030.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#031.src: Afterwards, they threw the book into the back garden, and forced a carnivorous plant to grow and consume my notes!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#031.dst: 后来，他们把书扔进后花园，还硬让一株食肉植物长出来，把我的笔记吞掉了！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#031.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#032.src: I assume when the desired information was found, they went into my garden, threw the book into the carnivorous plant and stormed off towards the lab.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#032.dst: 我猜他们找到想要的情报之后，就去了我的花园，把书扔进食肉植物里，然后气冲冲地往实验室去了。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#032.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#033.src: I have researched the Iridesca bloom, and many other plants, for a long time. All my knowledge is stored in that book!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#033.dst: 我研究 Iridesca 花和很多其他植物很久了。我所有的知识都记在那本书里！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#033.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#034.src: Retrieve it for me, and I will share my knowledge with you.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#034.dst: 帮我把它拿回来，我就把我的知识分享给你。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#034.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#035.src: Kill the carnivorous plant and loot the book
Aldorei's Secret Part I#035.dst: 杀死食肉植物，拿回那本书

Aldorei's Secret Part I#036.src: ...disgusting. I will have to hang the pages to dry later, but first, our exchange.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#036.dst: ……恶心。书页我得之后再晾干，不过先来完成我们的交换。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#036.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#037.src: Hmm... Herbstzeitlose... Death Whistle, no...where is Iridesca, again...?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#037.dst: 嗯……Herbstzeitlose……死亡哨草，不对……Iridesca 在哪来着……？
Aldorei's Secret Part I#037.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#038.src: Aha, there it is. The pages were sticking together. Iridesca leaves are potent in various ways and are very versatile in their use.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#038.dst: 啊哈，在这里。书页都粘在一起了。Iridesca 叶子有多种强效作用，用途非常广泛。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#038.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#039.src: They have an incredibly broad range of usage, from soothing joint pain or curing sickness to emetic effect and lethal poison, depending on what it is brewed with.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#039.dst: 它们的用途极其广泛，从缓解关节疼痛、治疗疾病，到催吐和致命毒药，全看它跟什么一起调制。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#039.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#040.src: Mm? The book thief also possesses Iridesca...? This... This is very troubling. There are few notes aside from mine on how to heal Iridesca poisoning.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#040.dst: 嗯？偷书贼也有 Iridesca……？这……这非常令人不安。除了我的笔记之外，关于怎么治疗 Iridesca 中毒的记载少之又少。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#040.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#041.src: They were headed in the direction of the potionmaker's guild. If they intend something wicked...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#041.dst: 他们朝药剂师公会的方向去了。如果他们打算做什么坏事……
Aldorei's Secret Part I#041.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#043.src: ..you! You have been seeking me! I have seen you tracing my footsteps...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#043.dst: ..你！你一直在找我！我看到你一路追着我的脚步……
Aldorei's Secret Part I#043.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#044.src: I apologize for this... But what I do is a necessity!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#044.dst: 对此我很抱歉……但我做的事是必要的！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#044.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#045.src: I beg you, do not pursue me any further!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#045.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#047.src: Outsider, I realize the circumstances appear damning, but you must stop!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#047.dst: 外人，我知道现在的情况对我很不利，但你必须停下！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#047.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#048.src: What I have done is needed, and if there were another path I would have taken it over this.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#048.dst: 我做的事是必须的，如果有别的路可走，我一定不会选这条。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#048.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#049.src: I must take my concoction to where it is needed!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#049.dst: 我必须把我的药剂送到需要它的地方！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#049.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#050.src: See me as I truly am- My name is Korben, and I musn’t be delayed further!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#050.dst: 看清我的真面目吧——我叫 Korben，我不能再被耽搁了！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#050.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#051.src: G R O W! (In High Gavellian)
Aldorei's Secret Part I#051.dst: 长 大 吧！(高等 Gavel 语)
Aldorei's Secret Part I#051.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#052.src: A damnable pace you have... I cannot let you stop me for a moment longer!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#052.dst: 你的速度真是该死的快……我不能再让你拦我一刻！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#052.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#053.src: It will be done soon, but I must reach my destination first!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#053.dst: 很快就好了，但我得先赶到目的地！
Aldorei's Secret Part I#053.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#054.src: Finally... I apologize for the delay. I needed to take strong measures to get this to you.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#054.dst: 终于……抱歉耽搁了。为了把这个带给你，我不得不采取强硬手段。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#054.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#055.src: Here, here... Drink, father. It will clear your throat.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#055.dst: 来，来……喝吧，父亲。它会让你的喉咙舒服些。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#055.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#056.src: ...there. It is done. Now... Outsider... Hear me, please.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#056.dst: ……好了。完成了。现在……外人……请听我说。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#056.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#057.src: I am aware of exactly what I have done. Shredded Fiona’s research, disturbed the forbidden gardens, unsettled the hearts of many...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#057.dst: 我很清楚自己做了什么。撕毁了 Fiona 的研究，惊扰了禁忌花园，让许多人心神不宁……
Aldorei's Secret Part I#057.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#058.src: My father fell ill. A trek to {p}’s borders left him stricken with Kerasot poisoning. He was near death...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#058.dst: 我父亲病倒了。去了一趟 {p} 的边境，他就中了 Kerasot 毒。他差点就死了……
Aldorei's Secret Part I#058.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#059.src: {p}’s village is one of outcasts- to visit is, stupidly, forbidden. He would have been exiled, and that would have ensured his death with his affliction.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#059.dst: {p} 的村子是被放逐者的村子——去那里拜访是被禁止的，真是愚蠢。他会被放逐，而以他的病情，那就等于判了他死刑。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#059.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#060.src: Desperation causes one to do strange things. I thought only of his safety- I cared little about anything else.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#060.dst: 绝望会让人做出奇怪的事。我只想到他的安危——其他的我都不在乎。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#060.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#061.src: Even now I am simply relieved for his safety. If you must turn me in, I understand- I have already done what I set out to do.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#061.dst: 即使到现在，我也只是为他平安而松了一口气。如果你必须告发我，我能理解——我想做的事已经做完了。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#061.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#062.src: Though I wish to remain free, whether you choose to report my activities or not does not matter to me now.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#062.dst: 虽然我希望保住自由，但你选择要不要举报我，现在对我来说已经不重要了。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#062.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#064.src: Traveler, I must remind you- The doors shall remain shut until the criminal has been found.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#064.dst: 旅人，我必须提醒你——在找到罪犯之前，这些门都会一直关着。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#064.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#065.src: ...ah. You have found him, then. The name is Korben... Understood. We shall interrogate him for his actions.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#065.dst: ……啊。那么你找到他了。名字是 Korben……明白了。我们会审问他的所作所为。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#065.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#066.src: This being the case... You may come and go as you wish to {p} Town. We shall re-open the doors.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#066.dst: 既然如此……你可以自由进出 {p} 镇了。我们会重新打开大门。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#066.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#067.src: ...you... You are... You would lie to the guards and say I perished in the chase? You will keep my identity secret?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#067.dst: ……你……你竟然……你要骗守卫说我在追逐中死了？你会替我保守身份的秘密？
Aldorei's Secret Part I#067.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#068.src: Outsider... You show generosity akin to my father. He passed his Sol Medallion onto me to continue his legacy...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#068.dst: 外人……你的慷慨就像我父亲一样。他把他的太阳奖章传给我，让我延续他的传承……
Aldorei's Secret Part I#068.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#069.src: ...after what I have done, I do not deserve it. You take it, instead. It is in sufficiently worthy hands, I believe.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#069.dst: ……做了这些事之后，我不配拥有它。你拿去吧。我相信它在你手里才算是值得。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#069.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#070.src: I shall beg the Light to shine upon you for the rest of your days. A thousand thanks to you.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#070.dst: 我会祈求光明在你余生的每一天都照耀你。万分感谢你。
Aldorei's Secret Part I#070.speaker: Korben
